scenes.question: What's happening in Rolls-Royce?
bullet_points: Open-fan front module testing advanced; ground trials planned by 2027
Core element could reshape propulsion architecture
Strategic implication: accelerate propulsion roadmap and partnerships
scenes.audio_script: Safran advances open-fan front module testing, targeting 2027 ground trials. This core element could reshape propulsion architecture, pressuring Rolls-Royce to accelerate adaptable core and partnerships to stay competitive.

scenes.headline_stat: DOT&E flags persistent US Navy aviation challenges
scenes.headline_caption: US Navy program headwinds impact propulsion market
bullet_points: DOT&E cites persistent challenges across US Navy aviation programs
Impacts on budgets, schedules, modernization timelines
Strategic implication: tighter budgets may slow RR propulsion program funding
scenes.audio_script: DOT&E flags persistent challenges across US Navy aviation programs, risking cost growth and schedule slips. That pressure could constrain modernization pipelines for buyers of RR propulsion, delaying upgrades or new engine programs.

scenes.question: How is the competition doing?
scenes.headline_stat: First upgraded RM12EP engine delivered to Gripen C/D
scenes.headline_caption: Gripen upgrade milestone tightens RR competitive gap
bullet_points: Sweden Air Force receives first upgraded RM12EP engine for Gripen C/D
Upgrade targets propulsion reliability and performance
Strategic implication: establishes pressure to match RR modernization pace
scenes.audio_script: Sweden delivers the first upgraded RM12EP engine for the Gripen C/D, boosting reliability and performance. The upgrade sets a benchmark for propulsion improvements, pressuring RR to accelerate comparable competitiveness in modern jets.
